verdict.rationale: The only sandbox evidence is a free, self-serve Recurly Engage sandbox described as a 'secure, streamlined sandbox environment' for internal engagement campaigns. Engage's Preview Tool also lets users validate prompts and segments before going live. Neither shows an isolated test environment for the core subscription billing API. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test mode for Recurly Subscriptions/API, test API keys or test payment gateways, an explicit statement that production data is kept separate, agent/MCP use against a sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
